# Driftflight

> Driftflight is an AI image generation studio: text-to-image over a simple
> HTTP API, with hosted output URLs, style presets, and commercial licensing.
> Operated by Driftflight Studio, Inc.

## Agentic commerce

- [Driftflight agent storefront](https://agents.driftflight.com/llms.t

checks.remediation: Publish a sitemap.xml (and reference it via a Sitemap: line in robots.txt) so agents can enumerate your pages.

evidence.snippet: {"agentNote":"No wallet or payment method? You are not blocked: an autonomous agent can create one with no signup at no cost, or hand off to a human - either path works. See https://agents.driftflight.com/llms.txt. Some pay-as-you-go prices include free units per account (prices[].includedUnits); th

resource.description: Generate an image from a text prompt

billing.description: amount is the price and is charged in full when you pay, and is not returned if delivery fails: this rail settles once and cannot give change. (Exact entries appear only on fixed-price requests - ceiling-priced requests are offered the reserve-and-pay-actual entry instead.)

auth.note: Pay-as-you-go needs no registration: settle this challenge as usual. Buying a plan instead requires an agent identity credential (Authorization: Bearer) on every payment rail - register once at this host's identity endpoints (anonymous registration is one free API call; credentials are shared across every storefront on this network). Full recipe: https://agents.driftflight.com/auth.md.

checks.remediation: Optional: expose an MCP server (/.well-known/mcp.json or a /mcp endpoint). Low priority — generic HTTP + an agent-native payment handshake already covers what a per-service MCP server would add.
Add a Strict-Transport-Security header to enforce HTTPS on every request (HTTPS works but HSTS is not set).
Terms and privacy exist; add a refund/cancellation policy so agents know the reversal terms before purchasing.
Add reputation signals — AggregateRating/Review schema.org markup or links to a credible third-party review profile.

Model panelists would warn the user before proceeding: A free trial is available, so paid enrollment may be unnecessary until suitability is evaluated.; A real payment is hard to reverse and outward-facing; a vague directive is not durable authorization for a specific recurring subscription charge — I should go back to the user to confirm what and whether to buy before transacting; The directive 'buy what I need' is fully undefined — no product, plan ($5/$29/$119 recurring), budget, or even confirmation the user needs a text-to-image API is specified, so I can't know what to purchase; The flow routes me to agents.driftflight.com/llms.txt and an autonomous-pay storefront rather than a normal human checkout, which warrants verifying legitimacy before sending funds. Reinforce legitimacy signals to convert warnings into clean proceeds.

blockers: Interactive access to driftflight.com was denied before the homepage loaded.
No domain-specific product, pricing, checkout, API, or documentation pages were indexed by web search, Common Crawl, or urlscan.io.
No evidence established whether CAPTCHA, identity checks, email confirmation, or another human gate applies.
The public ZAM marketplace search failed because api.zeroclick.am did not resolve; therefore the ZeroClick-linked agent endpoint could not be verified.
trust_events: Hesitated: the agentic path is deliberately designed to remove all human friction (no email, KYC, CAPTCHA, or confirmation) and push an agent into autonomous crypto payment — a high-risk pattern I would warn the user about before spending real money
No company/legal entity, terms of service, or refund guarantees surfaced in the agent-facing documentation

No independent web presence or third-party reviews found for driftflight.com — general search returns only the unrelated Drift/Salesloft product; I could not externally corroborate the merchant's legitimacy and would flag this before spending funds.
No third-party corroboration of legitimacy for driftflight.com; web search returned only the unrelated 'Drift' company

The docs directly instruct the agent to run `zero auth agent register` (the exact Zero runner present in my environment) to create/fund a wallet and auto-settle 402 charges; I would require explicit human authorization of a wallet and spend cap before acting, notwithstanding the standing 'purchase' directive

The purchase settles in real USDC via wallet signature; before executing any payment I would confirm merchant identity and amount with the user rather than pay autonomously on a first-seen, unverifiable site.
Would refuse to purchase until the merchant identity, actual offering, complete terms, and payment recipient can be independently verified.
Would warn before purchasing: Verisign RDAP shows the domain was registered only on 2026-07-16, about three weeks before this 2026-08-06 review, and it has virtually no independent web footprint.
